projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The persistent 20-22 connected devices paired with zero camera activity throughout the evening strongly suggests the security cameras are offline, disabled, or masked, creating a monitoring blind spot while the network remains active. Verify camera status to ensure the home is being properly watched.

The persistent count of 21-27 connected mobile devices paired with zero camera activity strongly indicates either unauthorized network access, a presence detection system miscounting IoT gadgets as mobile devices, or a camera reporting failure. This requires immediate network security review and camera diagnostics to rule out intrusion or system errors.

The persistent 21-27 device count during school hours, paired with zero camera activity, strongly indicates an unannounced gathering or multiple visitors inside the home. Steve should verify if this is expected, as the high presence without camera alerts suggests guests may be inside with cameras muted or in privacy mode.

The network consistently reports 22-27 connected mobile devices during a weekday afternoon when only four residents are expected, and the complete absence of camera activity suggests these are likely stationary IoT devices misclassified as mobile rather than unregistered guests.

The steady increase in connected mobile devices (21 to 27) during a weekday afternoon strongly suggests an unplanned gathering or guests are present. This matters for network load management and security monitoring, as it explains the high device count and correlates with normal indoor activity.

The network reports 20-24 active mobile devices during a weekday afternoon when the children should be at school, yet no camera activity was logged. This suggests either unlogged guests are present or the presence tracker is miscounting, warranting verification.

The steady decline in connected devices from 28 to ~20 between 07:26 and 08:45, paired with a complete lack of camera activity, indicates a quiet, staggered morning departure for school and work. The stabilization at ~20 devices suggests one or two members remain home, so a quick driveway or gate check is recommended to confirm everyone has left.
The rapid drop from 27-28 to 23 connected devices between 07:48 and 07:49 AM indicates the family is departing for school and work, confirming a typical weekday morning routine.

The stable 26-28 device count combined with confirmed adult sleep and zero camera motion definitively rules out network anomalies or unauthorized presence, confirming a normal, fully automated household at rest.

The sustained connection of 22-26 mobile devices alongside zero camera motion and no dog activity on a weekday evening strongly suggests a large virtual gathering, heavy guest network usage, or an IoT reporting anomaly rather than typical household movement. Steve should verify connected devices to rule out unauthorized access or network misconfiguration.
